"""候选明确不保留后，按本轮真实原字节备份恢复十一份来源；不构建或运行LP。"""

import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import zipfile


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
PLAN_SHA = "5f134f630f8f969097c2b9c2b85912a89b4f20ef224043303367d43754d1dd06"
BASELINE_SHA = "22f1b40f08a37ad1dcb62bd7a047581d637939c8dcd1cf0123102a64617a3048"
OUTPUT = DATA / "v66-restored-source.json"


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(content):
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def sha(path):
    return digest(Path(path).read_bytes())


def unique_object(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        require(key not in result, "JSON重复字段：" + key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def read_locked(path, expected):
    content = Path(path).read_bytes()
    require(digest(content) == expected, "输入身份不匹配：" + str(path))
    return json.loads(content.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
        parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("非有限JSON：" + value)))


def local_source(name):
    require(isinstance(name, str), "来源路径不是字符串")
    relative = PurePosixPath(name)
    require(not relative.is_absolute() and relative.as_posix() == name and "\\" not in name and ":" not in name and
        all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in relative.parts), "来源路径不规范：" + name)
    path = (ROOT / name).resolve()
    require(path.is_relative_to(ROOT) and path.is_file(), "来源路径越界或不存在：" + name)
    return path


def check_files(expected):
    actual = {name: sha(local_source(name)) for name in expected}
    require(actual == expected, "当前来源或库已经偏离冻结身份，禁止覆盖用户工作")
    return actual


def main(arguments):
    require(not OUTPUT.exists(), "禁止覆盖本轮既有恢复记录")
    require(all(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 64 and
        all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value)
        for value in (PLAN_SHA, BASELINE_SHA, arguments.identity_sha256,
            arguments.decision_sha256, arguments.backup_identity_sha256, arguments.backup_zip_sha256)),
        "撤回所需身份尚未最终锁定")
    plan = read_locked(DATA / "v66-plan.json", PLAN_SHA)
    require(plan["starting_state"]["file"] == "v65-restored-state.json", "恢复基线不是本轮实际起始状态")
    starting = read_locked(DATA / plan["starting_state"]["file"], plan["starting_state"]["sha256"])
    baseline = read_locked(DATA / "v66-baseline-check.json", BASELINE_SHA)
    backup = read_locked(DATA / "v66-starting-source.json", arguments.backup_identity_sha256)
    candidate = read_locked(DATA / "ipm-v66-identity.json", arguments.identity_sha256)
    require(candidate["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA and backup["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA and
        backup["baseline_check_sha256"] == BASELINE_SHA, "计划与候选或备份来源不一致")
    require(baseline["files"] == starting["files"] and baseline["libraries"] == starting["libraries"] and
        baseline["solver_sha256"] == starting["solver_sha256"], "起始检查与 v65 实际恢复身份不同")
    require(baseline["passed"] is True and backup["readback_verified"] is True and
        baseline["files"] == backup["files"] and baseline["libraries"] == backup["libraries"] and
        baseline["solver_sha256"] == backup["solver_sha256"], "原字节备份与真实起始状态不同")
    require(len(candidate["files"]) == len(backup["files"]) == 95 and
        set(candidate["files"]) == set(backup["files"]) and len(candidate["libraries"]) == 17,
        "来源或库集合不完整")

    decision_name = "v66-gate.json" if arguments.decision == "initial" else "v66-full-gate.json"
    decision = read_locked(DATA / decision_name, arguments.decision_sha256)
    require(decision["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA, "撤回决定不是本轮计划")
    if arguments.decision == "initial":
        require(decision.get("eligible_for_netlib") is False, "初始门槛没有明确拒绝候选")
    else:
        require(decision.get("candidate_identity_sha256") == arguments.identity_sha256 and
            decision.get("retain_candidate") is False and isinstance(decision.get("reason"), str) and
            bool(decision["reason"]), "完整评估没有针对该候选明确作出不保留决定")

    changed = plan["changed_source_files"]
    require(isinstance(changed, list) and len(changed) == len(set(changed)) == 11,
        "恢复范围不是计划十一份唯一来源")
    require(sorted(candidate["changed_source_files"]) == sorted(changed) and
        sorted(name for name in backup["files"] if backup["files"][name] != candidate["files"][name]) == sorted(changed),
        "候选相对起始状态的实际差异超出计划")
    targets = {name: local_source(name) for name in changed}
    archive_path = DATA / "v66-starting-source.zip"
    require(backup["source_zip_file"] == archive_path.name and
        sha(archive_path) == arguments.backup_zip_sha256 == backup["source_zip_sha256"], "起始原字节包身份不符")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        require(len(names) == len(set(names)) == 95 and set(names) == set(backup["files"]), "起始原字节包成员不符")
        contents = {name: archive.read(name) for name in names}
    require({name: digest(value) for name, value in contents.items()} == backup["files"], "起始原字节包内容不符")
    require(contents["tests/test_cli.py"].count(b"cls.benchmark.platform.platform()") == 1,
        "恢复目标未保留独立平台预热")

    candidate_archive = DATA / "ipm-v66-source.zip"
    require(sha(candidate_archive) == candidate["source_zip_sha256"], "冻结候选来源包身份变化")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(candidate_archive) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        require(len(names) == len(set(names)) == 95 and set(names) == set(candidate["files"]), "冻结候选成员不符")
        require({name: digest(archive.read(name)) for name in names} == candidate["files"], "冻结候选来源不符")
    check_files(candidate["files"])
    check_files(candidate["libraries"])
    frozen_candidate = ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe"
    current_executable = ROOT / "build/release/solver.exe"
    require(sha(frozen_candidate) == sha(current_executable) == candidate["solver_sha256"],
        "当前或冻结候选程序身份变化")

    # 所有决定、来源、路径、库与程序检查通过后，仅写回计划十一来源的原字节。
    for name, path in targets.items():
        path.write_bytes(contents[name])
    actual = check_files(backup["files"])
    libraries = check_files(candidate["libraries"])
    require(sha(frozen_candidate) == sha(current_executable) == candidate["solver_sha256"],
        "恢复来源意外改变候选程序")
    result = {"passed": True, "created_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA, "baseline_check_sha256": BASELINE_SHA,
        "candidate_identity_sha256": arguments.identity_sha256,
        "decision_file": decision_name, "decision_sha256": arguments.decision_sha256,
        "backup_identity_sha256": arguments.backup_identity_sha256, "backup_source_zip_sha256": arguments.backup_zip_sha256,
        "restored_files": changed, "source_files": len(actual), "files": actual,
        "platform_test_fix_preserved": True, "all_prechecks_completed_before_source_writes": True,
        "libraries_before_rebuild": libraries, "solver_binary_before_rebuild": candidate["solver_sha256"],
        "restored_numerical_source_version": "ipm-cpu-0.47.0",
        "binary_rebuild_required": True, "lp_runs": 0, "build_runs": 0,
        "restore_source_sha256": sha(__file__), "restore_source": Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode("utf-8")}
    with OUTPUT.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as target:
        json.dump(result, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        target.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "restored_files": len(changed), "source_files": len(actual),
        "binary_rebuild_required": True, "lp_runs": 0, "build_runs": 0}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--decision", choices=("initial", "full"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--identity-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--decision-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--backup-identity-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--backup-zip-sha256", required=True)
    main(parser.parse_args())

"""保存第63轮恢复后重建的来源、实际日志、完整驱动源码及失败。"""

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import traceback
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
PLAN_SHA = "5f134f630f8f969097c2b9c2b85912a89b4f20ef224043303367d43754d1dd06"
BASELINE_SHA = "22f1b40f08a37ad1dcb62bd7a047581d637939c8dcd1cf0123102a64617a3048"
RESTORED = True
PREFIX = "v66-restored-build"
LOG_PREFIX = "iteration-ipm-v66-restored-build"


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(content):
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def sha(path):
    return digest(Path(path).read_bytes())


def unique_object(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        require(key not in result, "JSON重复字段：" + key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def read_json(path, expected=None):
    content = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if expected is not None:
        require(digest(content) == expected, "输入身份不匹配：" + str(path))
    return json.loads(content.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
        parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("非有限JSON：" + value)))


def local_file(name):
    require(isinstance(name, str), "来源路径必须为字符串")
    relative = PurePosixPath(name)
    require(not relative.is_absolute() and relative.as_posix() == name and
        "\\" not in name and ":" not in name and
        all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in relative.parts), "来源路径不规范：" + name)
    target = (ROOT / name).resolve()
    require(target.is_relative_to(ROOT) and target.is_file(), "来源路径越界或缺失：" + name)
    return target


def file_map(expected):
    actual = {name: sha(local_file(name)) for name in expected}
    require(actual == expected, "文件已偏离预期身份")
    return actual


def main():
    record_path = DATA / (PREFIX + ".json")
    snapshot = DATA / (PREFIX + "-source.zip")
    log = ROOT / ".tools" / (LOG_PREFIX + ".log")
    saved_log = DATA / (PREFIX + ".log")
    detail = DATA / (PREFIX + "-ctest-detail.log")
    require(not any(path.exists() for path in (record_path, snapshot, log, saved_log, detail)),
        "禁止覆盖本轮已有构建证据")
    driver_bytes = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    record = {"driver_started_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "started_at_utc": None, "command": None, "returncode": None,
        "elapsed_seconds": None, "build_invocation_attempted": False, "source_sha256": {},
        "all_sources_sha256": {}, "sources_unchanged": None,
        "driver_source": driver_bytes.decode("utf-8"), "driver_sha256": digest(driver_bytes),
        "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA, "baseline_check_sha256": BASELINE_SHA,
        "error": None, "lp_runs": 0}
    returncode = 1
    before = None
    changed = []
    try:
        plan = read_json(DATA / "v66-plan.json", PLAN_SHA)
        baseline = read_json(DATA / "v66-baseline-check.json", BASELINE_SHA)
        require(plan["baseline_check"] == {"file": "v66-baseline-check.json", "sha256": BASELINE_SHA},
            "计划与真实基线不符")
        require(plan["starting_state"]["file"] == "v65-restored-state.json", "本轮基线必须为实际 v65 恢复状态")
        starting = read_json(DATA / "v65-restored-state.json", plan["starting_state"]["sha256"])
        require(baseline["passed"] is True and baseline["files"] == starting["files"] and
            baseline["libraries"] == starting["libraries"] and baseline["solver_sha256"] == starting["solver_sha256"],
            "真实基线与起始状态不同")
        anchor_path = DATA / ("v66-restored-source.json" if RESTORED else "v66-integration.json")
        anchor = read_json(anchor_path)
        require(anchor["passed"] is True and anchor["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA and
            anchor["baseline_check_sha256"] == BASELINE_SHA, "构建来源操作记录与计划不符")
        if RESTORED:
            require(anchor["files"] == baseline["files"] and anchor["binary_rebuild_required"] is True,
                "恢复后的来源与实际起始状态不同")
            libraries = anchor["libraries_before_rebuild"]
            executable_sha = anchor["solver_binary_before_rebuild"]
        else:
            require(anchor["before_files"] == baseline["files"] and
                anchor["libraries"] == baseline["libraries"] and
                anchor["solver_sha256"] == baseline["solver_sha256"], "集成前身份与真实基线不同")
            libraries = baseline["libraries"]
            executable_sha = baseline["solver_sha256"]
        changed = plan["changed_source_files"]
        require(len(changed) == len(set(changed)) == 11 and len(anchor["files"]) == 95 and
            len(libraries) == 17 and set(anchor["files"]) == set(baseline["files"]), "来源或库集合不完整")
        external_libraries = {name: value for name, value in libraries.items()
            if not Path(name).name.startswith("libsolver_")}
        require(len(external_libraries) == 8, "外部库集合不是预期八项")
        before = file_map(anchor["files"])
        file_map(libraries)
        require(sha(local_file("build/release/solver.exe")) == executable_sha, "构建前程序身份变化")
        record.update({"source_sha256": {name: before[name] for name in changed},
            "all_sources_sha256": before, "anchor_file": anchor_path.name,
            "anchor_sha256": sha(anchor_path), "starting_state_sha256": plan["starting_state"]["sha256"]})
        # 先保存并回读原字节；备份时发生并行来源修改也在调用构建前拒绝。
        with zipfile.ZipFile(snapshot, "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
            for name in sorted(before):
                archive.writestr(name, local_file(name).read_bytes())
        with zipfile.ZipFile(snapshot) as archive:
            names = archive.namelist()
            require(len(names) == len(set(names)) == 95 and set(names) == set(before), "构建来源快照成员不符")
            require({name: digest(archive.read(name)) for name in names} == before, "构建来源快照身份不符")
        file_map(before)
        file_map(libraries)
        require(sha(local_file("build/release/solver.exe")) == executable_sha, "备份期间程序身份变化")
        command = [r"C:\Users\ADMIN\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\powershell\pwsh.exe",
            "-NoProfile", "-File", str(ROOT / "scripts/build-windows.ps1"), "-Jobs", "4"]
        record["command"] = command
        test_log = ROOT / "build/release/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log"
        detail_before = (test_log.stat().st_mtime_ns, sha(test_log)) if test_log.exists() else None
        environment = dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8="1")
        # started_at_utc 严格在子进程调用前生成，不以完成记录时刻冒充开始。
        with log.open("xb") as output:
            record["started_at_utc"] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
            begin = time.perf_counter()
            record["build_invocation_attempted"] = True
            try:
                process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment,
                    stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                record["returncode"] = process.returncode
                returncode = process.returncode
            finally:
                record["elapsed_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - begin
        if test_log.exists():
            detail_after = (test_log.stat().st_mtime_ns, sha(test_log))
            record["ctest_detail_fresh"] = detail_before != detail_after
            # 编译失败时可能仍留旧CTest明细，保存时显式标注，不冒充本轮回归。
            shutil.copy2(test_log, detail)
        else:
            record["ctest_detail_fresh"] = False
        after = {name: sha(local_file(name)) for name in before}
        record["sources_unchanged"] = before == after
        record["external_libraries_before_and_after"] = file_map(external_libraries)
        require(before == after, "构建期间来源发生变化")
        if returncode == 0:
            require(record["ctest_detail_fresh"] is True, "成功构建没有生成本轮CTest明细")
    except Exception:
        record["error"] = traceback.format_exc()
        returncode = 1
    finally:
        # 即使子进程失败或启动异常，也保留已有原始日志和完整驱动来源。
        if log.exists():
            shutil.copy2(log, saved_log)
        record.update({"completed_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "source_snapshot": str(snapshot) if snapshot.exists() else None,
            "source_snapshot_sha256": sha(snapshot) if snapshot.exists() else None,
            "log": str(log) if log.exists() else None, "log_sha256": sha(log) if log.exists() else None,
            "build_log": str(saved_log) if saved_log.exists() else None,
            "ctest_detail": str(detail) if detail.exists() else None,
            "ctest_detail_sha256": sha(detail) if detail.exists() else None})
        with record_path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as target:
            json.dump(record, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
            target.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({key: record[key] for key in
        ("returncode", "elapsed_seconds", "sources_unchanged", "log", "error")}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if log.exists():
        print(log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")[-4000:])
    raise SystemExit(returncode)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""核实撤回后实际来源、构建与冻结程序身份，不重跑公开LP。"""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'

def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def read(name):
    return json.loads((DATA / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

assert not (DATA / 'v66-restored-state.json').exists()
baseline = read('v66-baseline-check.json')
restore = read('v66-restored-source.json')
build = read('v66-restored-build.json')
assert read('v66-verification.json')['passed']
assert build['returncode'] == 0 and build['sources_unchanged'] and build['ctest_detail_fresh']
assert build['error'] is None
files = {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in baseline['files']}
assert files == baseline['files'] == build['all_sources_sha256']
libraries = {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in baseline['libraries']}
external = [name for name in libraries if not Path(name).name.startswith('libsolver_')]
assert len(external) == 8 and all(libraries[name] == baseline['libraries'][name] for name in external)
with zipfile.ZipFile(build['source_snapshot']) as archive:
    assert len(archive.namelist()) == 95
    assert {name: hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest() for name in archive.namelist()} == files
assert sha(build['source_snapshot']) == build['source_snapshot_sha256']
assert sha(build['build_log']) == build['log_sha256']
assert sha(build['ctest_detail']) == build['ctest_detail_sha256']
log = Path(build['build_log']).read_bytes()
detail = Path(build['ctest_detail']).read_bytes()
assert b'100% tests passed out of 18' in log and detail.count(b'Test Passed.') == 18
test_seconds = float(re.findall(rb'Total Test time \(real\) =\s*([0-9.]+) sec', log)[-1])
frozen = {}
for version in (57, 60, 62, 64, 65, 66):
    actual = sha(ROOT / f'.tools/solver-ipm-v{version}.exe')
    assert actual == read(f'ipm-v{version}-identity.json')['solver_sha256']
    frozen[str(version)] = actual
solver_sha = sha(ROOT / 'build/release/solver.exe')
result = {
    'passed': True, 'created_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'selected_numerical_source': 57, 'source_count': 95, 'files': files, 'libraries': libraries,
    'starting_state_sha256': sha(DATA / 'v66-baseline-check.json'),
    'source_matches_starting_state': True, 'platform_test_fix_preserved': True,
    'libraries_different_from_starting_state': [n for n in libraries if libraries[n] != baseline['libraries'][n]],
    'solver_sha256': solver_sha, 'solver_matches_starting_state': solver_sha == baseline['solver_sha256'],
    'ctest_passed': 18, 'ctest_seconds': test_seconds,
    'restoration_record_sha256': sha(DATA / 'v66-restored-source.json'),
    'restored_build_record_sha256': sha(DATA / 'v66-restored-build.json'),
    'ctest_detail_sha256': build['ctest_detail_sha256'],
    'frozen_binaries_unchanged': frozen, 'lp_benchmark_runs': 0,
    'driver_source': Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode('utf-8'), 'driver_sha256': sha(__file__),
    'limits': ['来源逐字节恢复本轮起始状态，回归通过；未重测恢复程序的公开LP性能。',
               '如自有库或程序字节与起始重建物不同，保留实际身份，不据来源一致声称二进制一致。']
}
with (DATA / 'v66-restored-state.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ('passed', 'source_count', 'ctest_passed', 'ctest_seconds',
    'solver_sha256', 'solver_matches_starting_state', 'libraries_different_from_starting_state')}, ensure_ascii=False))

import json

import re
import zipfile

IDENTITY_SHA = '65666c21a39398fef278735be14c79f064579a231d19f014eabaa9c7f106cb5b'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def read(name):
    return json.loads((DATA/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

output = DATA/'v66-accepted-state.json'
assert not output.exists()
assert sha(DATA/'v66-plan.json') == PLAN_SHA
assert sha(DATA/'ipm-v66-identity.json') == IDENTITY_SHA
identity = read('ipm-v66-identity.json')
baseline = read('v66-baseline-check.json')
build = read('v66-build-attempt1.json')
verification = read('v66-verification.json')
assessment = read('v66-full-assessment.json')
assert verification['passed'] and verification['run_count'] == 500
assert verification['identity_sha256'] == IDENTITY_SHA
assert assessment['retain_candidate'] is True
assert assessment['candidate_identity_sha256'] == IDENTITY_SHA
assert assessment['plan_sha256'] == PLAN_SHA
assert build['returncode'] == 0 and build['sources_unchanged'] and build['ctest_detail_fresh']
assert build['error'] is None
files = {name:sha(ROOT/name) for name in identity['files']}
libraries = {name:sha(ROOT/name) for name in identity['libraries']}
assert files == identity['files'] == build['all_sources_sha256'] and len(files) == 95
assert libraries == identity['libraries'] and len(libraries) == 17
external = [name for name in libraries if not Path(name).name.startswith('libsolver_')]
assert len(external) == 8 and all(libraries[name] == baseline['libraries'][name] for name in external)
assert sha(build['source_snapshot']) == build['source_snapshot_sha256']
with zipfile.ZipFile(build['source_snapshot']) as archive:
    assert len(archive.namelist()) == 95
    assert {name:hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest() for name in archive.namelist()} == files
assert sha(build['build_log']) == build['log_sha256']
assert sha(build['ctest_detail']) == build['ctest_detail_sha256']
log = Path(build['build_log']).read_bytes()
detail = Path(build['ctest_detail']).read_bytes()
assert b'100% tests passed out of 18' in log and detail.count(b'Test Passed.') == 18
test_seconds = float(re.findall(rb'Total Test time \(real\) =\s*([0-9.]+) sec',log)[-1])
solver_sha = sha(ROOT/'build/release/solver.exe')
assert solver_sha == identity['solver_sha256'] == sha(ROOT/'.tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe')
assert b'cls.benchmark.platform.platform()' in (ROOT/'tests/test_cli.py').read_bytes()
assert 'std::string linear_solver = "qdldl";' in (ROOT/'include/solver/ipm_options.hpp').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
prepared = ['v66-restore-inline.py','v66-restored-build-inline.py','v66-restored-state-inline.py']
result = {
    'passed':True,'created_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'selected_numerical_source':66,'selected_explicit_linear_solver':'normal_cholmod_aat',
    'selected_explicit_accuracy':'homogeneous_repair','default_linear_solver':'qdldl',
    'default_changed':False,'source_count':95,'files':files,'libraries':libraries,
    'solver_sha256':solver_sha,'source_matches_candidate':True,'solver_matches_candidate':True,
    'platform_test_fix_preserved':True,'external_libraries_unchanged':8,
    'plan_sha256':PLAN_SHA,'identity_sha256':IDENTITY_SHA,
    'baseline_check_sha256':sha(DATA/'v66-baseline-check.json'),
    'verification_sha256':sha(DATA/'v66-verification.json'),
    'assessment_sha256':sha(DATA/'v66-full-assessment.json'),
    'build_record_sha256':sha(DATA/'v66-build-attempt1.json'),
    'ctest_detail_sha256':build['ctest_detail_sha256'],'ctest_passed':18,'ctest_seconds':test_seconds,
    'lp_benchmark_runs_by_this_driver':0,
    'prepared_not_executed_restore_helpers':{name:{'sha256':sha(ROOT/'.tools'/name),
        'source':(ROOT/'.tools'/name).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')} for name in prepared},
    'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),'driver_sha256':sha(__file__),
    'limits':['接纳是查看完整结果后的工程判断；冻结计划只有扩集门槛。',
              '保留显式实验内核，不改变默认qdldl；当前仍未达成打平HiGHS目标。',
              '候选源码、程序与链接库未再改变，因此复用实际首次18项回归，不重复测试。']
}
with output.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as target:
    json.dump(result,target,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
